name: TOL
description: Natural language provides an intuitive way to express spatial intent in geospatial applications. While existing localization methods often rely on dense point cloud maps or high-resolution imagery, OpenStreetMap (OSM) offers a compact and freely available map representation that encodes rich semantic and structural information, making it well-suited for large-scale localization. However, text-to-OSM (T2O) localization remains largely unexplored.
